utterance.raw:
Whoa, everyone, please hold on and think about this logically before you vote! I am not denying the timeline, but you're misinterpreting what happened. 

Yes, Charlie, I went from Medbay to Upper Engine. Yes, Frank, Alice and I were in Upper Engine and we walked down to Lower Engine together around tick 10. I'm not hiding that at all because I have nothing to hide! We both had tasks in Lower Engine. I finished my task quickly and headed into Storage, where Bob saw me arrive at tick 15. 

Here's the critical missing piece: **Alice was perfectly fine and alive when I left Lower Engine.** 

Think about Frank's story. He admits he was in Upper Engine watching us. He claims he went to Oxygen, but nobody has verified that. He knew exactly where Alice and I went. It is incredibly easy for Frank to have waited a moment, followed us down to Lower Engine, killed Alice after I left for Storage, and then self-reported to frame me using the fact that I was the last person seen with her. 

Frank is self-reporting to set up an easy misdirection. Bob, you know I came to Storage and just chilled with you. If I had just killed someone, why would I walk directly into you and hang around? I left her alive. Frank is the one who found the body because he's the one who created it. I'm voting Frank, and if you vote me, you're giving the Duck exactly what they want.
